thread:
sam: heads up 11 small UX/a11y thread: Encryption modal -> region + retention controls. i noticed when you pick a region the KMS ownership badge shifts and the retention help text drops below fold on small screens. erin: can you repro on mobile? i saw the badge jump too when the tenant name is long. sam: repro steps: open Security > Keys > Create key modal, choose Region: Europe (Frankfurt), Owner: VeryLongTenantNameThatWraps, Retention: 30 days (dropdown). on 375px wide the retention line moves under the action buttons. julia: that sounds bad. we should keep the primary actions visible and keep the retention hint anchored to the retention control. erin: agree. proposed fixes: - make retention control sticky to the bottom of the modal on small viewports - KMS ownership badge should be in the same inline affordance as the key name (not floated) - long tenant names truncate with full name available in a tooltip + accessible label sam: example truncation approach: show "VeryLongTenantNameTha..." visually, but include aria-label with full name on the element. also add a visible ellipsis + title attribute. julia: snippet suggestion: ``` VeryLongTenantNameTha... ``` erin: for the KMS badge: if we move it inline we avoid DOM reflow. remember to not hide it from screen readers; keep it as text inside the label: "BYOK (owned by Acme)" sam: question on retention copy. current copy in audit log uses: "Data retention: 30 days". security-team: is that ambiguous about deletion vs. archival? security-team: yes please be explicit. recommended: "Data will be deleted after 30 days unless archived by policy." or for keys: "Previous key versions remain usable for decryption for 30 days, then permanently deleted." julia: also change the retention dropdown options to include microcopy under each option, e.g., "30 days \u2014 immediate deletion after 30 days" so users don't misinterpret. erin: accessibility nit: retention dropdown should announce the microcopy when focused. we can put a visually-hidden description and tie it with aria-describedby. example: ```
30 days: previous keys usable for decryption for 30 days, then deleted.
``` sam: design-bot ran contrast + focus testing: design-bot: "Contrast failure on .microcopy (2.5:1). Focus ring missing on KMS badge when tabbed. Landmark order ok but modal close button not first interactive element." julia: we should make close button first in tab order and ensure the badge gets a focusable element (e.g., a button or link) if it provides info. erin: timeline: aiming to ship the modal improvements in next console patch (wednesday). i'll pick up sticky footer + aria-describedby. sam will update mocks and tooltip behavior. julia will update microcopy for retention and audit log. security-team will sign off on final wording. sam: assigning: sam (design) update mocks, erin (eng) implement sticky footer + aria-describedby, julia (content) update copy, security-team approve. I'll run a quick mobile SR pass after changes. security-team: noted. will review copy in 24h. julia: tiny friendly reminder: keep copy consistent with console audit entries & email notifications. sam: thanks all :raised_hands:
notes: Discussion about modal layout for Encryption/Keys: region selection moves KMS badge, retention help text visibility on small screens, truncation + tooltip/aria-label approach for long tenant names, explicit retention wording for audit logs, aria-describedby for retention microcopy, design-bot accessibility findings, and clear action items + owners.
